title: Mutual Information and Profiled-Attack Success in Higher-Order DPA
summary: Experiments link mutual information to profiled-attack success in second- and higher-order DPA, but a formal justification of this relationship remains open.

formal_statement.body: In second- and higher-order differential power analysis (DPA), experiments exhibit a relationship between mutual information and the success rate of a profiled attack. Formally analyze and justify this relationship, for example under the assumption that leakage noise is Gaussian.

scope.domain: Side-channel cryptanalysis of profiled attacks using second- and higher-order differential power analysis.
assumptions: Gaussian leakage noise as an example assumption
parameters: DPA order — second- and higher-order attack setting
scope.unresolved_remainder: Formally analyze and justify the experimentally observed relationship between mutual information and profiled-attack success rate.

citations.label: The World Is Not Enough: Another Look on Second-Order DPA

progress.summary: The paper experimentally exhibits the relationship in second- and higher-order DPA. It leaves a formal justification for future analysis and suggests Gaussian leakage noise as one possible assumption.
citation_labels: François-Xavier Standaert et al., The World Is Not Enough: Another Look on Second-Order DPA
